capabilities: Render a parametric 3D robot inside the Obsidian window
Drag the pet to reposition it and trigger click feedback
Customize size, color scheme and position in settings
Toggle pet visibility from the status bar or command palette
Animate idle behaviors like breathing, blinking and swaying
extras: Works on desktop and mobile; on touch devices gestures starting on the pet are suppressed by design. Includes known-limitations list and future roadmap (note integration not yet implemented). Not reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's window offers no playful decorative element; the workspace is purely functional with nothing visual to interact with.
summary: 3D cartoon robot pet built with Three.js that floats inside the Obsidian window and can be dragged, clicked, resized and recolored.
